name: KDTreeSamplingPartition
definition: A distributed partitioning algorithm that builds a k-d tree structure over spatial data points by recursively splitting blocks along coordinate dimensions. It uses a sampling-based approach to determine split positions and manages neighbor links via a reduce proxy.
summary: KDTreeSamplingPartition is a domain decomposition algorithm that dynamically splits volume rendering samples across compute blocks using random sampling to determine k-d tree split positions.
